technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term technicals conflicted; oversold conditions with some reversal signals (stoch cross, cmf cross) lack conviction without price confirmation above key moving averages or trend strength.

fundamental.summary: CMS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 37 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295), FOMC decision in 1 day creates imminent event risk, and utilities face credit stress in tightening environment; earnings in 37 days adds secondary uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term moving average structure (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200) remains bullish with OBV and CMF crosses suggesting accumulation, while extreme fear (16/100) and oversold stochastic present classic contrarian reversal setup near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 295, FOMC decision in 1 day), zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, high earnings risk in 37 days), price trapped below all short-term moving averages, and weak trend strength (ADX 19) create unacceptable risk/reward despite technical oversold conditions.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (16/100) and oversold stochastic present contrarian reversal setup with long-term moving average support, macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC decision in 1 day) and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC decision in 1 day combined with inverted yield curve and earnings in 37 days creates compounding event risk that could trigger sharp reversal despite technical oversold conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 15 positions in Utilities sector; adding CMS would increase concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment.
